name: Infrastructure Projects Planning and Implementation
description: Introduction to infrastructure projects, characteristics of infrastructure related to transportation, power generation, water supply, irrigation, urban and rural infrastructure, roles of stakeholders, project stages, financial and risk management, and challenges in infrastructure development, process of delivering infrastructure projects, addressing infrastructure problems through case studies of complex projects, regulatory frameworks, funding mechanisms, sustainable practices, tools and techniques for strategic planning techniques, skills to manage infrastructure projects, economic and environmental management in respect of large engineering projects.
